initial_query: I am looking for an existing school building. I intend to create a spring section (sezione primavera), integrated into an existing kindergarten. I need a property with at least 180 sqm of gross floor area and capacity for 14 people.
submitted_query: I am looking for an existing school building. I intend to create a spring section (sezione primavera), integrated into an existing kindergarten. I need a property with at least 180 sqm of gross floor area and capacity for 14 people.
final_sql: SELECT * FROM ESTATES WHERE property_type = 'Attività scolastiche' AND surface_area >= 180 ORDER BY id ASC

requirements.description: The user explicitly requires at least 180 sqm of gross floor area, so this is a direct total-surface threshold. The capacity of 14 people is not converted into an area filter, since no verified gross-area threshold per occupant was provided.

output.sql: SELECT * FROM ESTATES WHERE property_type = 'Attività scolastiche' AND surface_area >= 180 ORDER BY id ASC
output.explanation: Filters on the two extracted requirements: property_type is 'Attività scolastiche' (school activities) and surface_area >= 180 sqm. The requested capacity of 14 people has no matching column, so it is not filtered. No location was supplied, so results are ordered by id ASC.
